## Changes

### Library
- Sort bookmarks from the layers button, now **Group & sort**: last updated, title, total chapters, latest chapter, date added or last read. Tap the selected order again to reverse it.
- Bookmarks remember when they were added. Comics bookmarked before this version sort by their last update instead.

### Reading
- **Continue reading** opens the next chapter once the last one you read is finished. If that was the newest chapter, it opens it as before. The Home card shows which chapter is next.

### Migration
- **Import from Mihon / Tachiyomi** now brings each comic's chapter list, the exact chapters you read (gaps stay unread) and when you read them, so progress, History and Continue reading are right straight away. Import the same backup again to fill in comics imported with an older version; nothing gets marked unread.
- **Import from Comix.to** asks which source to search the titles in. Comix is picked by default.
